title: Introduce schema rollback safety net and Terraform plan canary
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: reduce blast radius from failed schema migrations and terraform drift during private upgrades. This PR implements a multi-layer safety net: 1) a preflight 'schema rollback safety' controller that captures migration intent, computes a reversible migration plan and produces an idempotent rollback script; 2) an automated restore-rehearsal harness that runs synthetic restores against a sandbox cluster using the existing snapshot catalog; 3) a Terraform Plan Canary module that applies plans to an isolated canary namespace and verifies resource diffs before allowing cluster-wide apply; and 4) helm post-upgrade verification hooks that validate CRD compatibility and seatbelt short-circuit (quiesce operator, verify websocket KV replay). The description below lists what changed, test/CI outcomes, and rollback instructions. This PR targets release/v1.12 as a safety-first patch for upcoming private upgrades.
commits: 1) add rollback safety controller and reversible-plan library; 2) add terraform/plan-canary module and example pipeline; 3) add restore-rehearsal script + sandbox job; 4) helm: post-upgrade-verifier job and chart values; 5) docs: upgrade playbook additions and runbook snippets; 6) tests: e2e rehearsals and unit coverage for reversible-plan
review_comments: Maya: Can the reversible-plan library handle non-transactional DDLs (ALTER TYPE, drop column)? Please document limitations.
Author (Asha): The current implementation annotates non-reversible steps and will block canary promotion; added a docs section that enumerates limitations and manual remediation steps.
Liam: Terraform canary job looks good but we should ensure state locking is never targeted at prod statefile. Add explicit backend overrides.
Author (Asha): Added backend override and isolated S3 bucket configuration for canary pipeline; test artifact shows no writes to prod state.
Jian: CI flake on e2e rehearsal initial run — looks like timing assumptions in operator quiesce. Requested a retries/backoff fix.
Author (Asha): Updated quiesce logic with exponential backoff and added idempotent timeouts. Re-ran rehearsals and CI passed.
Maya: Approve on safety grounds after confirming docs and runbook additions.
release_notes: Adds reversible migration plans, automated restore rehearsals, Terraform plan canary pipeline, and Helm post-upgrade verifications to reduce upgrade blast radius. Operators should read docs/upgrade_playbook.md before scheduling tenant upgrades.
